_doc: Archetypes the scaffolder knows. Each gives DEFAULTS the intake can override: capabilities, DOX scopes, constraints, owner gates, the smoke check, an AGENTS.md section, and extra template layers. Pick the closest; 'other' is a valid answer. Add one by appending an entry and a case in scaffold/tests/test_scaffold.py (CONTRIBUTING.md).

constraints: No secrets in source or in committed files: configuration comes from environment variables or a secret store, and `.env` is gitignored.
Every behaviour change ships with a test that fails without it; a rule that cannot be tested is labelled advisory.
New work lands in its architectural home (Place Before Building); a second implementation of an existing seam is a defect.
gates: Push to `main`, force-push, or rewrite published history
Deploy to production or change production infrastructure
Spend money or create paid resources (API credits at scale, cloud resources)
Send email, messages or posts to real people, or call third-party write APIs outside a sandbox
Delete data or resources the session did not create
Write or rotate credentials, or change who has access

web-app.title: Web application
web-app.description: A browser UI plus a server: pages, an HTTP API, auth, persistence.

scopes.title: Web UI
scopes.covers: The browser UI: pages, components, client state, styling.

scopes.title: API server
scopes.covers: The server: HTTP routes, auth, domain logic, data access, background jobs.

scopes.title: Shared packages
scopes.covers: Libraries used by more than one app: types, clients, utilities.
scopes.not_owns: anything only one app uses (keep it in that app)

constraints: Access control is decided on the server; the client is never trusted for who may see or change what.
Every API route has a test that calls it; every user-visible flow has one end-to-end check.
gates: Run a database migration against a shared or production database
web-app.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): the URL and the text that proves the app is up, e.g. start the dev server, then `curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q '<title>'`. For a UI change, also take a screenshot of the changed page.
web-app.section:
## Architecture Notes

- UI and server are separate scopes even inside one framework: data access and secrets never live in client components.
- Migrations are expand/contract and forward-only (DELIVERY.md §10).
- Risk tier HIGH: auth, payments, migrations, tenancy, deploy config.

api-service.title: API / backend service
api-service.description: A headless service: HTTP or RPC API, workers, persistence.

scopes.title: Service source
scopes.covers: Routes/handlers, domain logic, data access, background workers.

scopes.title: Tests
scopes.covers: Unit, integration and contract tests; fixtures.

constraints: Every endpoint has a test that calls it, including its error paths.
Handlers stay thin: domain logic lives in modules a test can call without HTTP.
gates: Run a database migration against a shared or production database
api-service.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): the health check, e.g. start the service, then `curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health` → `{"ok": true}`.
api-service.section:
## Architecture Notes

- Migrations are expand/contract and forward-only (DELIVERY.md §10).
- Risk tier HIGH: auth, money, tenancy, migrations, deploy path.

cli.title: Command-line tool
cli.description: A command-line program: argument parsing, commands, output.

scopes.title: CLI source
scopes.covers: Argument parsing (thin) and the command implementations (testable without a shell).

scopes.title: Tests
scopes.covers: Unit tests of commands and end-to-end runs of the binary on fixtures.

constraints: `--help` works for every command; exit codes are documented and non-zero on failure.
Output meant for scripts is stable (JSON or a documented format); human output may change.
gates: Publish a release to a package registry
cli.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): the commands that prove it works, e.g. `<cli> --help` exits 0 and `<cli> <command> <fixture>` prints the expected line.

library.title: Library / SDK
library.description: A reusable package other code imports: a public API, versioned releases.

scopes.title: Library source
scopes.covers: The public API and its internals.

scopes.title: Tests
scopes.covers: Tests of the public API (behaviour, not internals).

constraints: The public API is explicit; a breaking change bumps the major version and is listed in the changelog.
Every public function has a test and a docstring example that runs.
gates: Publish a release to a package registry
library.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): a snippet that imports the package and calls one public function, with its expected output.

data-pipeline.title: Data / ML pipeline
data-pipeline.description: Batch or scheduled jobs that extract, transform, train or report.

scopes.title: Pipeline source
scopes.covers: One module per pipeline step; each step reads a declared input and writes a declared output.

scopes.title: Tests
scopes.covers: Step tests on small fixtures; one end-to-end run on a sample dataset.

constraints: Steps are deterministic and idempotent: the same input gives the same output, and a re-run is safe.
Raw data and large artifacts are never committed; the pipeline records where they came from.
gates: Write to a production database, warehouse or bucket
Start a paid compute job (GPU, cluster)
data-pipeline.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): run the pipeline on the sample fixture and check the output, e.g. the output file exists and has N rows.
data-pipeline.section:
## Architecture Notes

- DOE applies directly: each step is a deterministic script with a declared input and output; the agent orchestrates and judges.
- Small run first: every step accepts a limit or sample flag.

agent.title: Custom agent (DOE harness)
agent.description: An agent that does a specific job: skills (directive + scripts) orchestrated by an LLM, with run records and self-annealing. Runs in the IDE (Claude Code / Copilot) or on CommandCenter.

scopes.title: Skills
scopes.covers: One folder per capability: SKILL.md (the directive) + scripts/ (execution) + tests/.
scopes.not_owns: code shared by 2+ skills (.tmp/scripts/), reference data (agent-data/)
rules: Create skills with `skill-authoring`; never hand-write a proxy in .claude/skills/.
A skill's Definition of Done is checkable by a command.

scopes.title: Shared utilities
scopes.covers: Python modules used by two or more skills (on PYTHONPATH in hosted runs).
scopes.not_owns: single-skill code (stays in the skill), one-off scratch (rest of .tmp/)
rules: Every module here has a test: two skills break when it does.

scopes.title: Reference data
scopes.covers: Permanent assets the agent reads: catalogs, templates, specs, images.
rules: Every asset is listed in INDEX.md.

constraints: Never fabricate: the agent reports only what its scripts and sources returned.
Skills with `authority: external` or `cost_tier` 2+ run `--dry-run` first and need the user's go-ahead.
Every run leaves a record in outputs/<run-slug>/ (run_store.py).
agent.smoke_check: Run one skill on a small sample from `inputs/` and check its record: `python .tmp/scripts/run_store.py list` shows the run with status `success`, and its step files hold the expected fields. TODO(scaffold): name the sample input and the expected output once the first skill exists.

mobile-app.title: Mobile app
mobile-app.description: An iOS/Android app, optionally with a backend.

scopes.title: App source
scopes.covers: Screens, components, state, platform integrations.

constraints: Every screen handles loading, empty and error states.
Secrets never ship in the app bundle; the backend holds them.
gates: Submit a build to an app store or a public test track
mobile-app.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): build and launch on an emulator/simulator, open the changed screen, and save a screenshot.

desktop-app.title: Desktop app

scopes.title: App source
scopes.covers: UI and app logic.

constraints: The app starts with no network; features that need it fail with a clear message.
gates: Publish a signed release or an auto-update
desktop-app.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): launch the dev build, check the window opens on the expected screen, and save a screenshot.

firmware.title: Embedded firmware
firmware.description: Firmware for a microcontroller (PlatformIO, ESP-IDF, Zephyr).

scopes.title: Firmware source
scopes.covers: Application code and drivers.

scopes.title: Tests
scopes.covers: Native (host) unit tests and on-target tests.

constraints: Logic that can run on the host has a native unit test; hardware access sits behind a thin interface.
No blocking calls in interrupt handlers; timing assumptions are written next to the code.
gates: Flash a device that is in the field or connected to real equipment
firmware.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): build (`pio run`), run native tests, and if a board is attached, flash and read the boot line from the serial monitor.

monorepo.title: Monorepo (several apps and packages)
monorepo.description: Several deployable apps and shared packages in one repository.

scopes.title: Apps
scopes.covers: Deployable units, one folder each, each with its own AGENTS.md.

scopes.title: Packages
scopes.covers: Libraries shared by more than one app.

constraints: An app never imports another app; shared code moves to packages/.
gates: Run a database migration against a shared or production database
monorepo.smoke_check: TODO(scaffold): the per-app smoke checks (one line each).

other.description: Anything else: the agent defines scopes from the intake.
